sights.w: Newton Circus Food Centre opened in 1971 as a tourist-friendly open-air hawker centre at the Newton roundabout; rebuilt in 2006 and immortalised as the satay-and-chilli-crab feast in Crazy Rich Asians. With close to 100 stalls it placed five on the 2025 MICHELIN Bib Gourmand list — the most of any hawker centre — and is the gastronomic heart of Newton.
